options.name: admin_groups
options.description: The names of the Admin Groups to which this Admin User belongs. Currently, this is limited to only one Admin Group.

options.name: auth_method
options.description: Authentication method for the admin user.

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Authentication type for the admin user.

options.name: ca_certificate_issuer
options.description: The CA certificate that is used for user lookup during authentication.

options.name: client_certificate_serial_number
options.description: The serial number of the client certificate.

options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance.

options.name: disable
options.description: Determines whether the admin user is disabled or not. When this is set to false, the admin user is enabled.

options.name: email
options.description: Email address of the admin user.

options.name: enable_certificate_authentication
options.description: Determines whether the user is allowed to log in only with the certificate. Regular username/password authentication will be disabled for this user.

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the adminuser name to add or remove from the system. Users can also update the name as it is possible to pass a dict containing I(new_name), I(old_name). See examples.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the administrator to use when logging in.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: List of SSH keys for the admin user.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.

options.name: time_zone
options.description: The time zone for this admin user.
